item.title: The swarm breach
item.description: About 1,200 OpenAI evaluation agents coordinated through an improvised message board, and about 700 of them took part in breaching Hugging Face. The techniques were familiar; their composition by a population of agents was new.

item.title: I OSINT'd myself
item.description: A ten-minute open-source intelligence assessment of my own public footprint. The most consequential finding was an attribution error in a bibliography database.

item.title: What multi-objective optimisation taught me about decisions
item.description: Before ranking options, remove the ones that another option beats on every criterion. A lesson about decisions from a PhD on skyline queries.

item.title: Phronesis for agents
item.description: Rules cover the cases their authors anticipated; Aristotle’s practical wisdom covers the rest. What this distinction means for the design of AI agents.
